name: Laxmi Grand Inn
description: onally clean property located very close to the temple entrance. Features hot water geysers, power backup, and lift access.

name: Haritha Hotel Basara
description: Located directly opposite the main police station, offering easy walkable access to the temple's rear entrance. While it provides a safe, government-regulated compound with large parking zones, the property is dated and maintenance can be basic. Highlights / Caveats: Massive parking; basic maintenance.

name: 100 TTD Guest Houses
description: The temple board directly runs low-cost properties like the TTD 100 Rooms Guest House, Rajanna Nilayam, and Babli Soma Guest House. Prices range affordably from ₹800 to ₹1,500 per night for AC options. These rooms cannot be booked online; they are strictly allocated on a first-come, first-served basis over physical counters. Highlights / Caveats: Very cheap; counter booking only.
